item.summary: docs(apps): time-box the progress-card legacy plan fallback to 2026-10-18 (#125643) The stream:"plan" fallback on both native platforms is deliberate compatibility debt with a fixed expiry, not a permanent contract. Record the sunset date, point each platform at its twin and at the tracking issue, and correct the Android note to v2026.8.x (the newest released tag also lacks progressCard.get). Refs #125639
